item.title: [IGNITE-17299] .NET: The constructor to deserialize an object of type 'System.OrdinalCaseSensitiveComparer' was not found
item.description:
We have a model created with Nswag. The model has additional properties, by which all unknown fields are parsed.

private System.Collections.Generic.IDictionary<string, object> _additionalProperties = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, object>();

[Newtonsoft.Json.JsonExtensionData]
public System.Collections.Generic.IDictionary<string, object> AdditionalProperties
{
    get { return _additionalProperties; }
    set { _additionalProperties = value; }
}

If the nested model is saved in additional properties, it is saved as KeyValuePair<string, object>. The object is a JArray containing a JObject.

When writing data to the cache, everything is fine. But when retrieving data from the cache an error occurs: 

 
The constructor to deserialize an object of type 'System.OrdinalCaseSensitiveComparer' was not found.

item.summary: .NET: The constructor to deserialize an object of type 'System.OrdinalCaseSensitiveComparer' was not found

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
I've reproduced the problem, thanks for the report.

It is indeed a bug in Ignite, another corner case with ISerializable mechanism where OrdinalIgnoreCaseComparer is ISerializable and writes as OrdinalComparer which is NOT ISerializable.

Unfortunately, I see no workarounds (other than changing the application code to avoid storing JArray and JObject in Ignite, which I would actually recommend). We'll fix this for the next release.
ptupitsyn Approved. Left a single comment though.
